blurb: Guests join guided boat tours to see dolphins in their natural habitat, enjoy sunset cruises with views of the coastline, and explore local landmarks with insights into marine life and history. Tours are family-friendly and led by expert captains. The experience includes dolphin sightings almost always, making it suitable for all ages.
hoursText: Open Daily (7 Days a Week) 9 am - 9 pm

quotes.text: SO MANY DOLPHINS!!!! I would definitely recommend Flippers Fun Boat — really great way to get off land and see Clearwater Beach + surroundings from the water. The guide was great — lots of fun anecdotes that made an already pretty scenic ride even more interesting.

Out of the three dolphin tour excursions we have done over the last 11 years in Clearwater, THIS WAS BY FAR THE BEST! The staff were FANTASTIC and worked with other tour boats to give us the best ever experience of watching and seeing dolphins.
